timeline.body:
Assert JSONs not as strings, but as maps, so we don't depend on the order of the fields in the JSON object. 

Fixes #82831

timeline.message:
Serialize PutPrivilegesResponse to XContent in a consistent order

So we don't depend on the internal iterator of `HashMap` which is variable.

Fixes #82831
timeline.author: Artem Prigoda

timeline.body:
Isn't the map creation in the test itself still problematic since the response is going to be in natural order but here we're still using a hashmap?

If there's no expectation on ordering here I really think the _better_ thing to do is make the test more robust and indifferent to ordering rather than have to have to use stable collections all over the place.

reply.body: Good point @mark-vieira! I've reverted the change in `PutPrivilegesResponse` and amended the assertions to check the JSONs not as strings, but as maps.

timeline.author: Artem Prigoda
